name: Star Energy Group PLC
summary: Star Energy Group Plc is an energy enterprise primarily engaged in the exploration, development, and extraction of oil and natural gas within the United Kingdom. The company possesses interests across fifty onshore licenses, spread over key locations such as England's Weald Basin (southern region), the Gainsborough Trough in the East Midlands, the Bowland Basin in the North West of England, and Scotland's Inner Moray Firth. Beyond its core hydrocarbon operations, the firm also produces electricity. By December 31, 2021, Star Energy Group Plc had estimated proved and probable reserves amounting to 15.79 million barrels of oil equivalent. Established in 2003 as IGas Energy plc, the company's headquarters are situated in London, United Kingdom.
